Episode 265

3 Necessities to a Successful Catholic Marriage

August 27, 2026

LISTEN ON:

Episode 265: 3 Necessities to a Successful Catholic Marriage

Listen to audio version of this article
Sponsored by
0:00 / 0:45
Instaread

There is always the temptation to keep score. Every little disagreement becomes a legal discussion, and you try so hard to win the case and walk away victorious. But it costs you. 74% of divorced people say their spouse should have worked harder. 73% say they themselves had already done enough. Both cannot be true.

Today we discuss the importance of not making your marriage a constant battle to win and how wanting to win can cost you your marriage. We learn to listen to our spouse’s heart, not just their words, and to recognize that our needs are God-given. Devin and Kim Schadt have been married thirty years, through cancer, poverty, miscarriage, and a daughter’s brain injury. In their new book The Marriage Gap, they lay out the three things every thriving marriage does.
